name: Gelatine
aliases: Gelatine, gelatin, gelatina, gélatine, animal gelatine, pork gelatine, beef gelatine, fish gelatine, E441
what_is: A gelling agent and protein obtained by boiling the skin, tendons, ligaments, and bones of animals.
why_botia: It flags it because it is always of animal origin and its status under Islamic law is highly dependent on the source animal and slaughter method.
can_1: Confirm that the product contains ingredients of animal origin.
can_2: Flag the product as doubtful (mashbooh) or unlawful (haram) for Muslim consumers if no halal certification is present.
cannot_1: Identify the specific animal species (such as porcine or bovine) from which the gelatine was extracted.
cannot_2: Determine if the animal was slaughtered according to Islamic rites.

sources.label: Codex General Standard for the Labelling of Prepackaged Foods (CXS 1-1985)
